fields.name: question
fields.note: The forecast question to answer. Should be a binary or probabilistic question about a future event (e.g. 'Will Arsenal win the Premier League this season?').

fields.name: resolution_criteria
fields.note: Optional. How the question resolves — what observable event determines the outcome.

fields.name: context
fields.note: Optional. Additional context: current standings, recent form, injuries, market odds, or any evidence the analyst should weigh.

fields.name: deadline
fields.note: Optional. When the question resolves (ISO 8601 date or natural language).
